fact: The General Education Sector Plan 2023-2027, dated November 2023, describes the South Sudan Schools' Attendance Monitoring System as large-scale data collection conducted by partners, not government, which the ministry cannot link to its own databases for want of a harmonised school list and unique school IDs, and plans a harmonised data platform bringing together the census, SAMSS, HRIS and REMIS, with an EMIS policy and strategy to be developed in 2024.
title: General Education Sector Plan 2023-2027
publisher: Republic of South Sudan, Ministry of General Education and Instruction
